caption: The drawing consists of two kitchen utensils, both resembling forks, rendered in black line art on an off-white or beige background. Each utensil has a handle with a cylindrical shape featuring decorative crosshatch or crisscross patterns in the center section, bordered by sets of parallel horizontal bands near the top and bottom. The utensil on the left has a straight handle and a straight, three-tined fork end. The utensil on the right has a similar handle but with a rightward bend at the top of the fork, resulting in a curved, three-tined fork end. The outlines are clean and uniform, and the only colors present are the black lines of the drawing against the light background. The utensils are depicted side by side, upright, with the tines of the forks at the bottom portion of the objects.
title: Pickle Fork
